jobs.employer_name: KiTA An der Bucerius Law School e.V
jobs.description: Create your own happiness!Are you a passionate early childhood educator (m/f/d)? Do you put your heart and soul into your work, but haven’t been satisfied with your working conditions so far?Come check us out—maybe you’ll like what you find here?What you can look forward to…The basics: pay, vacation time, and working hours.We are actually offering a fixed-term full-time position. The full-time workweek is 38 hours. Initially, the contract would be fixed-term, but an extension is possible.Pay is based on the TVöD SuE collective bargaining agreement and depends on your professional experience and qualifications. A 13th month’s salary (at 100%, instead of 85%) is paid after one year of service. We have between 32 and 34 days of vacation per year. Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve are paid holidays. The cost of an HVV/Deutschlandticket is fully covered, and if interested, you can participate in a fitness program.The Position: Responsibilities and Working Conditions.We are looking for at least one new early childhood educator with a perfect command of the English language.Your responsibilities include the attentive care, nurturing, and support of the children (age 1-6) entrusted to us in line with our educational approach, working closely with the children, parents, and the entire team. In your daily work, you would speak mainly English.We would appreciate at least some experience in this field and a preference for this age group would be advantageous.Our working conditions are truly worth highlighting: In the elementary section, four colleagues together care for 35 children; in the nursery section, four additional colleagues care for 16 children. In addition, we employ a housekeeping staff member with educational qualifications and, in the future, a substitute.We hold weekly team meetings to discuss weekly schedules, activities, and specific situations, as well as to plan parent-teacher conferences and developmental meetings. Our sponsoring organization places great emphasis on providing good working conditions.The Team: One for all, all for one!Some of us have been working together successfully and happily for over ten years. It goes without saying that we support one another and treat each other with care. Our sense of humor and our willingness to stand up for one another carry us through the sometimes hectic daily routine of the daycare center.On concept days, we discuss educational topics, engage in professional development, and reflect on our work. Regular weekly team meetings, preparation time, and supervision are just as much a part of our routine as extended get-togethers during company outings and Christmas parties.Has this piqued your curiosity? Then you should definitely keep reading…Important: Empathy, joy, and qualifications.To ensure we comply with legal requirements, it is very important that our new team member holds a completed, state-recognized qualification as an early childhood educator (m/f/d), a degree in early childhood education or early childhood development, or a degree as a social pedagogue (m/f/d). It would be helpful if you have a good understanding of the English language, as we are a bilingual facility.We are looking for an empathetic person with a Reggio Emilia approach (including a child-centered perspective) and someone who genuinely enjoys working with children, because we want you to look forward to coming to work.Feel free to get to know us!The Daycare Center: Location. Concept. Focus Areas.The daycare center is located in the heart of Planten un Blomen and is surrounded by plenty of greenery. It is easily accessible by public transportation from all parts of Hamburg (Gänsemarkt, Dammtor, Stephansplatz).There are two groups, a nursery group and an elementary group, in which 42-48 children are currently cared for by nine early childhood educators. Our facilities allow us to organize various projects and activities in workshops and specialized rooms.The foundation of our concept is the Reggio approach. Above all, it reflects our attitude toward others and how we wish to approach life’s changes. Our daycare is a place for self-directed, holistic learning, and we foster a respectful approach not only toward the children entrusted to us, but toward all people.We integrate key areas such as yoga, woodworking, art studio work, language development, music, relaxation and movement, and preschool preparation into our daily routine. Do you have a particular focus? A passion? Let’s find out together if we can integrate this into our daily routine as well…Start up initiative: Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.Our small operator, “Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.”, was founded in 2008 and is a member of the Paritätischer Wohlfahrtsverband Hamburg. Loki Schmidt was the founding patron of our daycare center.Our organization consists of a single facility. This means that decisions can be made and implemented quickly, easily, and on an individual basis. Here, people are still allowed to be people; they are heard and are not just a personnel number.As a member of the Bucerius family and an initiative of the ZEIT STIFTUNG BUCERIUS, our work makes an important contribution to promoting an open, democratic society.The Future: Do you think we’re a good fit for you?Then please send us your application materials. We would love to get to know you.If you’re interested, feel free to check out our website (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita) ) or our Instagram account (kita.buceriuslaw).Thank you for your attention, and we hope to see you soon!

Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.About UsThe Hannover Medical School (MHH), with about 10,000 employees the biggest company of Lower Saxony, is a university institution for research and teaching in the human and dental medicine and a university hospital of supra-maximum medical care. Research, teaching, medical care and administration work hand in hand in the integration model at the MHH-campus.The Peter L. Reichertz Institute for Medical Informatics (PLRI) is one of the largest university centres for medical informatics in Germany. It belongs to two leading universities, is situated in one of Europe's most research-intensive regions, and offers excellent opportunities for research. In interdisciplinary projects, the PLRI collaborates with health centres, research institutes, corporations, and public institutions in order to shape the future of the health system and medicine. The activities range from diverse topics on the local level, to regional, national, and global collaborations.The research group "Clinical Data Science" focuses on the detection of novel routine clinical and -omics biomarkers for disease diagnosis and prognosis to personalize and thus improve patient treatment. To achieve this, we integrate phenotypical information and routine clinical as well as (multi)-omics data by high-dimensional statistics and state-of-the-art artificial intelligence to gain novel insights into underlying disease pathomechanisms. Moreover, we are interested in developing and implementing research data platforms for complex (multi-)omics data. The project "MALDIDive: Enabling AI Research with Public MALDI-TOF Fingerprints across Microbial Diversity", to be carried out within an interdisciplinary research team and funded by the German Research Foundation, will establish a well curated data platform of MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry datasets from the Leibniz Institute German Collection of Mircoorganisms and Cell Cultures GmbH (DSMZ). We are looking for an enthusiastic PostDoc who is interested in omics data platform development and deployment for future AI use.Your Responsibilities- data platform architecture, backend, and frontend development as well as deployment for MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry database/platform and associated metadata- development of interactive data visualization concepts and their implementation into data platform- development and realization of short explanatory videos for platform users- co-organization and co-leading of stakeholder workshops to define user requirements and conduct user test cycles- presentation to the scientific community, i.e., by publishing in high-level journals and via presentations at international conferences- close collaboration with interdisciplinary project partners from AI / data science, analytical, and micro­biological research communities, particularly the DSMZ- bachelor / master student co-supervisionYour Profile- PhD / Dr. rer. nat. / Dr.-Ing. degree in data science / bioinformatics / computational biology / informatics / physics or similar research fields- expertise in the work on databases, interactive platform development, -omics and biomedical data, and / or artificial intelligence / machine learning- proficiency in backend / frontend development and / or database programming, including one or more of the following programming languages: VueJS, TypeScript, SQL, PYTHON, R Shiny, nginx, Docker, etc.- proficiency in English (written and oral)- desired: experience with code documentary systems and RestAPI- desired: knowledge of the German languageWe offer- a full-time position initially limited to two years with 38.5 hours per week at one of the largest employers in the state of Lower Saxony- depending on your individual qualifications, a salary according to TV-L salary group E13 is possible, with the benefits associated with public sector employment (e.g. occupational pension scheme and supplementary insurance through VBL)- an exciting role at the interface of research, healthcare and science management- a supportive induction process within a motivated and interdisciplinary team- support to pursue postdoctoral career (e.g., mentoring programs, etc.)- working in a highly motivated and cooperative research team of scientists- excellent perspectives for your scientific career development and networking- individual training and further education opportunities- a comprehensive company health management - because your health is important to us

jobs.description: Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. The role involves driving product adoption, supporting client growth and serving as the main advocate for client interests across different functions and regions.You will also lead your team by setting clear direction and providing continuous support. You will foster a collaborative and high-performance culture and encourage professional growth. You will ensure that your team’s work aligns with Client Success strategies and help them navigate complex challenges in support of our clients.This role provides an opportunity to contribute to our Client Success transformation. You will work with cross-functional partners to deliver strong outcomes for clients and support the ongoing development of your team. The Director Client Success reports to the Head of Client Services Central Europe and Eurozone Operations and is based in Frankfurt.Responsibilities include:- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Client Success team. Set clear goals and expectations, provide regular feedback, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented culture- Align your team’s work with the overall Client Success strategy.
